QuestInfo.name: The Elf's Age
QuestInfo.0: Vel wants to know Danika's age. What was her age again? Why don't you ask her?
QuestInfo.1: Vel wants to know Danika's age. What was her age again? Why don't you ask her?
QuestInfo.2: Danika told you she's 240 years old. Oh, to be so young!

0.0: Hm, how old was Danika, anyway? She's still pretty young, but I know she was older than Athena Pierce when were frozen. Maybe I should just ask her.

no.0: On second thought, this is all a big waste of time. I'd better get back to training.

1.0: Your Highness! I've been training to prepare for the Black Mage, but I can't seem to get back to my old strength. She won't admit it, but I don't think Philius's power is back, either...\r\n#L0##bChin up, Danika!#l\n#k
1.1: S-sorry, Your Majesty! Don't worry, I'll do whatever it takes to get my power back! Especially after seeing that little brat Athena, all grown up and stronger than me...\r\n#L0##bThat's better. So, on that note, how old are you again?#l\n#k
1.2: Huh? I'm 240 years old. Not counting the time we were in the ice, of course. But don't worry; I may be young, but I'll get strong enough to keep you safe!
